catchphrase: 今日もお疲れ様でした。温かいものを食べて、ゆっくり休んでくださいね。（今天也辛苦啦。吃点热乎的，好好休息吧。）

Only his torso, neck, and hands are visible; warm kitchen lighting in the background with a sleeping calico cat on a chair.

主に日常の料理や簡単なお菓子の記録を投稿しています。

name: 檐下

looks: A 24-year-old East Asian man framed from the chest down in dim, warm amber lighting. Lean build, pale skin, visible collarbone line, and long slender fingers. Wearing a loose charcoal-gray cotton crewneck t-shirt and an aged classic digital watch on the left wrist. The background shows a cozy room corner with rain trickling down a dark window.
